remarks: Both sets capture only the '1" EITHER SIDE' half of the note 'MIN. 12" CLEAR ABOVE AND 1" EITHER SIDE', dropping the 12" above-clearance condition — an important fact both miss. The framing claim stores the unit as a bare quote mark while the value already carries inches ('2"X6"'), a formatting quirk present in both sets. Neither set picks up the dimensional strings on the section (2' - 5 5/16", 2' - 0", 6") or the 1/2" MDF FIN. W/ P3 finish callouts, which are the main engineering content of this part.
